# pnpm.test runs the `test` script by default, or another named script, of a
# package; a failing script fails the target, and a fix reruns it.
[!exec:pnpm] skip

bit good
stdout 'good ▶ pnpm --filter calc run test$'
stdout 'good │ 1 \+ 2 = 3'
stdout 'good ✔ ok'

bit good
! stdout '✔ ok'

! bit bad
stdout 'bad ▶ pnpm --filter calc run check$'
stdout 'bad │ check failed'
stdout 'bad ✘'
stderr 'target ''bad'''

# A failed test runs again even when nothing changed.
! bit bad
stdout 'bad ▶'

cp check.fixed.js packages/calc/check.js
bit bad
stdout 'bad ✔ ok'

cp add.broken.js packages/calc/add.js
! bit good
stdout 'good │ 1 \+ 2 = -1'
stdout 'good ✘'

-- BUILD.bit --
deps = pnpm.install {}

good = pnpm.test {
  package    = "calc"
  depends_on = [deps]
}

bad = pnpm.test {
  package    = "calc"
  script     = "check"
  depends_on = [deps]
}
-- pnpm-lock.yaml --
lockfileVersion: '9.0'

settings:
  autoInstallPeers: true
  excludeLinksFromLockfile: false

importers:

  .: {}

  packages/calc: {}
-- pnpm-workspace.yaml --
packages:
  - "packages/*"
-- package.json --
{ "name": "root", "private": true }
-- packages/calc/package.json --
{
  "name": "calc",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "scripts": { "test": "node test.js", "check": "node check.js" }
}
-- packages/calc/add.js --
module.exports = (a, b) => a + b;
-- add.broken.js --
module.exports = (a, b) => a - b;
-- packages/calc/test.js --
const add = require("./add");
const got = add(1, 2);
console.log(`1 + 2 = ${got}`);
process.exit(got === 3 ? 0 : 1);
-- packages/calc/check.js --
console.log("check failed");
process.exit(1);
-- check.fixed.js --
console.log("check passed");
